oauth.githubExplainer: By signing in with GitHub, you can use your existing GitHub account to access our services. This allows for a seamless login experience and eliminates the need to create a new account. Your GitHub credentials will not be shared with us, and we will only request the necessary permissions to authenticate your identity.
oauth.fortyTwoExplainer: By signing in with 42, you can use your existing 42 account to access our services. This allows for a seamless login experience and eliminates the need to create a new account. Your 42 credentials will not be shared with us, and we will only request the necessary permissions to authenticate your identity.

cookie.title: EU Cookie & Privacy Notice
cookie.description: Trans Edit uses strictly functional cookies and local storage to provide essential services such as user authentication, session security, and theme preferences. In accordance with EU Directive 2002/58/EC (ePrivacy) and GDPR Art. 6, all cookies used on this site are strictly necessary for core functionality.
cookie.descriptionStrong: We do not use any advertising, profiling, or third-party tracking cookies.
cookie.detailsSubtitle: The following technical storage items are set by this website for core site functionality:

token.purpose: Stores your authenticated session (JWT) to keep you logged in and secure real-time collaboration.

theme.purpose: Remembers your interface display theme preference (light or dark mode) across browser visits.

consent.purpose: Remembers your acknowledgment of this EU cookie disclosure to prevent repeated popups.
